art_instructions: Inside the cozy attic bedroom with sloped wooden beams, show three small wooden beds in a row from left to right, each with forest‑green blankets, under warm lamplight from a tiny lantern on a nightstand. In the left bed, Panda (round panda cub) sleeps on his back with eyes closed and a small smile, one paw resting on the blanket; a soft rug and his little acorn pouch sit on the floor beside the bed. In the middle bed, Koala (small gray, big fluffy ears) sleeps curled on her side with eyes closed; her leaf‑green scarf is neatly folded over the bedrail, and a couple of Z’s drift above her head. In the right bed, Dinosaur (small pea‑green with pale mint belly and tiny dorsal nubs) sleeps on his side with tail tip peeking out from the blanket; his small red backpack is placed on the floor by the bed. Owl is awake: perch her on the footboard of the middle bed, facing the other animals, with bright open amber eyes and a gentle expression; her green scarf is visible, and one wing is slightly raised as if speaking. A small speech bubble near Owl reads «καλὴ νύξ». In the back wall, include a small rounded window with a crescent moon and faint stars, while the glowing lantern on the nightstand provides the main warm light. Make the room consistent with the series style: wooden floor, soft rugs, shelves with a few stuffed animals and picture books, but no mice present yet.
